findings.description: Undocumented arguments return `(metavar, None)` instead of `(metavar, "")`, causing help formatting to fail when documented and undocumented arguments are mixed.
findings.rationale: When a command has at least one argument with help text and another whose help is unset, the positional-arguments section passes both records to `formatter.write_dl`. The undocumented argument's description remains `None`, which fails when the formatter measures the table's string widths. Users requesting help get an exception instead of help output; the previous fallback supplied an empty string.
